explanation: Thread `threadIdx.x` of block `blockIdx.x` handles element `blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x`. Rounding the block count up with `(n + threads - 1) / threads` covers every element, and the extra threads of the last block must skip the write: `i < n`, not `i <= n`, since the last valid index is `n - 1`. Forgetting the check is the most common kernel-round bug; it writes past the end of `c` and may not even crash.
